headline: SpaceX launches Crew-13 to ISS, commanded by Jessica Watkins
summary: SpaceX launched four astronauts on the Crew-13 mission to the International Space Station, commanded by Jessica Watkins, who becomes the first Black woman to lead a crew into orbit. ArsTechnica separately reports SpaceX described a surgical intervention before the launch.

claims.statement: SpaceX launched four astronauts to the ISS on the Crew-13 mission, commanded by Jessica Watkins.

sources.quote: Four astronauts rocketed into orbit on Thursday on a space station mission that will stretch until spring
SpaceX describes surgical intervention before launch of latest crew mission

claims.statement: Jessica Watkins is the first Black woman to lead a crew into orbit.

sources.quote: Jessica Watkins, the first Black woman to lead a crew to orbit, is making her second trip to the space station
With Crew-13, Jessica Watkins became the first Black woman to lead a mission into space.
